programme.title: Rindu Yang Terlarang
programme.desc: Ainnura berbohong dengan Fariz yang bengkak di kepalanya akiat terhantuk pada sinki. Dalam waktu yang sama, Rohana mendakwa Ainnura sengaja menolaknya sehinggakan dia hampir terjatuh. Fateha menyokong kata-kata Rohana, menyebabkan Fariz keliru siapakah yang benar di antara isteri dan ibunya. Ainnura bangkit mempertahankan haknya. Selain daripada Ainnura, Fawwaz turut menjadi mangsa Rohana dan Fateha dengan pelbagai penghinaan sehingga akhirnya kerana tidak sanggup melihat Fawwaz dihina, Fazira mengakui yang Fawwaz adalah anaknya.

programme.title: Rindu Yang Terlarang
programme.desc: Fateha dan Rohana terkejut apabila mengetahui Fawwaz adalah anak Fazira hasil hubungan terlarang dengan Raja Azali iaitu kekasih Fateha. Pada mulanya mereka tidak percaya tetapi ketika mereka hendak mendapatkan penjelasan daripada Raja Azali, Raja Azali telah ditangkap polis atas beberapa tuduhan merogol. Fariz meminta maaf di atas sikap Rohana selama ini. Ainnura telah lama memaafkan Rohana tetapi mahu Fariz menceraikannya kerana dia tidak mahu Fariz menjadi anak derhaka gara-garanya. Rohana terharu dengan sikap baik Ainnura dan merayu kemaafan daripada Ainnura.

programme.title: Rindu Yang Terlarang
programme.desc: Selepas kematian Tok Wan, Ilah berhasrat untuk membatalkan perkahwinan Ainnura dengan Fariz. Bagaimanapun Ainnura bertegas untuk meneruskan rancangan mereka kerana itu juga yang dimahukan oleh Tok Wan demi meliah keluarga Ainnura dan keluarga Fariz berdamai. Rohana menyokong keputusan Ainnura dan ini menyebabkan Ilah kecil hati dengan Ainnura. Ilah akhirnya tidak hadir pada hari perkahwinan Ainnura.

programme.title: Rindu Yang Terlarang

Rohana paksa Ainnura tinggal bersamanya dan jika Ainnura menujuk Fariz supaya keluar dari rumah tersebut, dia tidak halal susu yang diminum oleh Fariz serta menganggap Fariz anak derhaka. Sementara itu, dalam diam Ilah sebenarnya merindui Ainnura.

programme.title: Rindu Yang Terlarang

Bagaimanapun Ainnura enggan kerana tidak mahu Fariz dianggap sebagai anak derhaka. Gara-hara terlalu marah dengan Ainnura, Rohana telah menghentak kepala Ainnura ke dinding. programme.title: Biarkan Cinta Tersenyum Lagi
programme.desc: Kisah penulis lagu Maya Arisa yang menghidap tumor otak dan mengimpikan untuk berkahwin. Dia kemudiannya bertemu dengan seorang jurugambar bernama Redza.

programme.title: Ayat Dari Langit
programme.desc: Ustaz Muiz dan isterinya mengajar ajaran sesat dan mahu pengikutnya mengikut telunjuk mereka yang lama kelamaan mula membuatkan pengikutnya bernama Kamal mula merasa sangsi.

programme.title: Cinta Round 1
programme.desc: Farid is a nerdy guy who always been bullied by Syakirin, his senior. Farid determined to enter an MMA tournament organized by their university so to put an end to being bullied by Syakirin.

programme.title: Racun Suami Jahanam
programme.desc: Suraya is a naive village girl who looks forward to happy days when Hazrul proposes to her. But those happy days are only temporary when she learns who Hazrul really is.

programme.title: 6 Hari
programme.desc: Suzi is content with being a third wife and living alone in her bungalow as she only entertains her husband every 6 days. Everything comes crashing when a person from her past returns to her life.

programme.title: Please Subscribe Cintaku
programme.desc: Hannah and her friend Alia have gone to an abandoned construction site to find material for her YouTube channel, but she unknowingly records a murder.

programme.title: Diva Dari Jakarta
programme.desc: Erin dan Ejot sering dibandingkan dari segi paras rupa. Sehingga suatu hari sesuatu telah berlaku kepada Erin yang mengubah segalanya.

programme.title: Diam Tanda Setuju
programme.desc: Kisah dua sahabat baik yang berhadapan dengan konflik perhubungan di saat mereka mula panik memikirkan usia mereka yang semakin meningkat tetapi belum bertemu jodoh.

programme.title: Nasiya
programme.desc: Ketika melarikan diri dari bekas suaminya, Ihyana telah mengalami kemalangan tetapi dia bernasib baik kerana telah diselamatkan oleh satu entiti luar biasa yang telah mengubah kelakuannya.

programme.title: Suamiku Encik Beruang
programme.desc: Ani, the most beautiful girl in the village, who is ever man's fantasy, decides to marry Mr. Bear as her husband, much to everyone's surprise. As for the chief village, he intend to organise the "wedding of the year".

programme.title: Satu Kampung Dua Orang

programme.title: Asam Pedas Cendol Sejoli
programme.desc: Karim adalah pemilik kedai cendol bersebelahan dengan kedai asam pedas Kalsom. Mereka bermusuhan, tetapi anak mereka – Kinah dan Khalil – mencintai satu sama lain, dan terpaksa menyembunyikan perkara ini bagi mengelakkan perang antara dua kedai mereka.

programme.title: Tolong Saya Encik Dinosaur

programme.title: Cubit - Cubit Cinta

programme.title: Duit Kawin

programme.desc: Despite J.T.’s efforts to change his fate and the cooperation of Sikorski, the clock ticks inexorably towards J.T.’s demise. They soon learn that Roy Bremmer’s lawyer had his client released from custody hours earlier.

programme.desc: It's a time of fun and play as Cody's family grows! Cody learns he's going to be a big brother and spends a special day with his mama and her baby bump. He has mixed feelings about the new baby but learns to be a caring older sibling, even helping put his sister Kendi to sleep. The fun continues as Cody celebrates his own special day with a dinosaur-themed birthday party.

programme.title: Lellobee City Farm
programme.desc: It's always cool to be cool on Lellobee City Farm! A penguin visits and teaches everyone how to stay cool on a hot day. A new rooster is having trouble remembering how to crow, but Ella helps him figure it out. The ducklings have their first flying lesson and the friends clean out the pond to give the animals a nice new home. Plus, celebrate the Moon Festival with a special party.

programme.title: Lellobee City Farm
programme.desc: Get ready for a farming sing-along! When Ella is feeling anxious, she does the five senses shakedown to feel better. Plus, learn that it's okay to make mistakes and that tidying up can be fun.

programme.title: Little World
programme.desc: Get ready for some evening sing-along fun! The family finds five little ducks by the lake and helps Itsy Bitsy Spider get back home. At a party, the twins learn the importance of choosing healthy snacks. They also learn to be kind to each other, have a fun playdate and play a game of peek-a-boo. At the end of the day, they learn how to use the potty with a happy potty dance.

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: The sun has set, but Baby John isn't ready for sleep! Follow him as he tries to delay bedtime with one last game. His patient parents guide him through a soothing routine, from a warm bath to a sweet lullaby, showing him that getting ready for bed can be a comforting and happy time after a long day of fun.

programme.title: Little Baby Bum
programme.desc: Get ready for bedtime with Mia. She says goodnight to all her toys and does some calming animal yoga. Daddy shows her how to brush her teeth with a fun dance. Twinkle helps make bath time a fun party. When her little brother can't sleep, Mia sings him a sweet lullaby. Plus, the moon and the stars fly over the town and say goodnight to everyone.

programme.title: Little Baby Bum: Lullabies
programme.desc: Little Baby Bum is here to help you fall to sleep with soothing, relaxing animated lullabies. These gentle and sensory videos are accompanied by lullaby versions of much-loved nursery rhymes, helping to take you to the land of nod.

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: What's on the menu today? Fun! Join JJ as he learns why it's great to eat vegetables with the 'Yes Yes Vegetables' song. Then, get your hands ready for a fun time in the kitchen as he sings and claps along to 'Pat-a-Cake.' It's a delicious and musical tale about our favorite foods.

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: This story is a celebration of family! Follow JJ through a day spent with the people he loves most. He sings a special song for his mommy and another for his daddy, showing how much he appreciates them. It's a heartwarming tale about the joy and love that comes from being with your family.

programme.title: JJ's Animal Time
programme.desc: Get ready for an Animal Time Sing Along! JJ and his friends work together to get a boat to an island full of apples and bananas. A bunny gets left behind by the bus, but his friends help him get on. A sneaky wolf tries to steal a blueberry pie and Mimi builds a rocket to see if the moon is really made of cheese. Plus, JJ puts on a show for all his animal friends and learns how to be a pirate.

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Get ready for some song and dance! Baby John is excited for his first day of school. The family goes camping and when it gets dark, they learn there's nothing to be afraid of. Baby John learns to keep trying when he can't get a yo-yo to work and the friends learn to share at school. Jill pretends to be a princess and Baby John wants to be just like his big brother.

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Baby John is on a mission to be healthy and strong! He learns that eating colorful vegetables can be a delicious adventure and that washing his hands keeps pesky germs away. When he feels a little under the weather, a visit to the doctor helps him learn how to get better, proving that healthy habits are the key to having fun every day.

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Get ready for playtime! The friends learn how to be safe at daycare and on the playground. They play a fun game of 'Red Light, Green Light' and have fun with arts and crafts. Even a rainy day can be fun when you have friends to play with. Jill pretends to be a princess and the whole family plays a game of 'the floor is lava.'.

programme.title: Lellobee City Farm
programme.desc: Get ready for some singing fun at Lellobee City Farm! Learn your ABCs in the Boogie Barn and then learn how to wash your hands before eating some delicious dumplings. Help Ella play 'Mummy Duck' and keep all the baby ducks together. When accidents happen, sing a boo boo song to feel better. End the day with a special Chinese lullaby from Grandma Mei at a sleepover.

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: Press play on a day of musical fun! Follow JJ and his friends as they go on adventures, with a special song for every moment. They sing about their families, their animal friends, and the fun of playing together. This story is a journey through the wonderful, song-filled world of CoComelon.

programme.title: Dance Party
programme.desc: Have some fun and dance with JJ and his friends! Put on your firefighter hat and dance, then celebrate the sights and sounds of spring. Sing about yummy vegetables, colorful jello and how much you love your friends. Go on a big adventure with Jack the Mouse as he climbs a giant beanstalk and dance with Ramona the seal from the circus.

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: When a boo-boo or a cough slows JJ down, he learns that a visit to the doctor can be a positive experience. Join him as he gets a check-up and finds out that doctors are friendly helpers who can make us feel better. This story shows that with a little care, you'll be back on your feet in no time.

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Get ready for some fun in the mud! Jill tries to keep Baby John and Bingo from playing in the mud, but she ends up joining in on the fun. The boys have a healthy competition at a fruit-themed play park. Baby John has a fun playdate with his grandpa and his vintage motorbike. Mom helps Baby John get ready for school and the family helps him learn that it's okay to ask for help.

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Who says exercise can't be a game? In this active adventure, Baby John discovers just how fun it is to move his body. He dances to upbeat songs, plays chase at the park, and learns simple, fun exercises. It's a wonderful tale that shows how being active is a happy and healthy way to play.

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Getting ready for the day is an adventure in itself! In this musical journey, Baby John learns all about healthy routines. He sings a fun song while brushing his teeth, learns how to wash his hands all by himself, and discovers that getting dressed is a fun puzzle. He shows how simple songs can make everyday tasks exciting.

programme.title: ARPO
programme.desc: Brace yourself for a series of wacky inventions and robotic mishaps! Arpo faces everything from a harmless kitchen timer he mistakes for a bomb to a drone that won't leave him alone. When a multiplying ray gets into the wrong hands, it creates more trouble than anyone can handle. These adventures are a fun look at how technology and curiosity can lead to the most unexpected and comical situations.

programme.title: ARPO
programme.desc: Prepare for pandemonium! Arpo and Daniel's attempt at gardening takes a dangerous turn when their plant grows into a monstrous creature that tries to eat everyone. As if that's not enough, the new 'smart' house system goes haywire, and the furniture starts a rebellion. It's up to Arpo to fix the pandemonium in this action-packed adventure.

programme.title: ARPO
programme.desc: It's robot vs. robot in this chaotic story! Arpo's day takes a wild turn when he has to deal with a very stinky diaper situation that affects the whole city. Then, he faces off against his rival, Nannybot, in a battle for a picnic spot. To top it all off, a robotic lawnmower goes rogue, and Arpo has to save the day. It's a hilarious tale of robotic mayhem!

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: Being a good friend is the best! Join JJ as he learns some very important lessons. When his friends want to play, he discovers the joy of sharing. Through a day of play, he learns that saying 'please' and 'thank you' and being kind makes every game more fun for everyone.

programme.title: Dance Party
programme.desc: Welcome to a delightful dance party! Stomp your feet like a dinosaur at Dino Land then do the robot dance on a space-themed stage. Cool off with a summer sprinkler dance and learn how to say 'please' and 'thank you' in ASL. Play a game of freeze dance, use your imagination to pretend you're on an adventure and end the day with a fun pajama dance party.

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: Join JJ as he learns that chores and routines can be fun! When it's time to tidy up his toys, the 'Clean Up Song' makes it a breeze. When it's time to get ready, the 'This is the Way' song helps him get dressed all by himself. This story shows how a good song can make any task a fun activity.

programme.title: Morphle
programme.desc: An unusual wave of mayhem is sweeping through Petport, and the resulting chaos is making all the babies incredibly cranky! It's up to Mila and Morphle to fix the problems and restore peace. Their mission begins when they confront a giant pizza monster terrorizing the streets. Just as they solve that, a giant robot starts rampaging through the city, adding to the cranky-inducing chaos they must stop.

programme.title: Morphle
programme.desc: When things go missing and mysteries arise, Detective Mila is on the case! With her ever-reliable partner Morphle, she's ready to solve any puzzle. Morphle transforms into all the tools a good detective needs-a magnifying glass to find clues, a key to unlock secrets, and a cage to trap the culprit-in this exciting and magical mystery adventure.

programme.title: Morphle
programme.desc: Mila and Morphle are having a day focused on helping little ones, but their plans are thrown into chaos by one baby-sized problem after another! First, they have to spring into action to save a friend's baby carriage when it starts rolling away. Soon after, they discover a group of adorable but naughty baby Morphles running wild through the city, forcing them to find a way to round them all up safely.

programme.title: Gecko's Garage
programme.desc: Meet the newest member of the garage crew: Baby Bus! This story follows her on her very first day. She's a little nervous, but with the help of Gecko and her new friends, she learns all about her important job and discovers the unique things that she can do. It's a sweet tale about finding your place and being proud of who you are.

programme.title: Gecko's Garage
programme.desc: There's always something exciting happening at Gecko's Garage! Today, a cement mixer has made a big mess, and a monster truck has a flat tire. Gecko must use all his tools and skills to help his vehicle friends get back on the road. It's a story about problem-solving and the joy of helping others.

programme.title: Gecko's Garage
programme.desc: Get ready for a day of boo boos and rescues! The trouble starts when Max breaks his suspension during a basketball game. Then, Gecko gets his own boo boo while fixing a bus and needs Grandma's help to finish the job. The adventures continue with a treasure hunt where a winch breaks, a game of hide-and-seek where a Mechanical gets lost and even Grandma causes some trouble while sleepwalking.

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Baby John wants to be just like his daddy when he grows up! Follow a day of fun where Baby John copies his dad's every move. From 'helping' with tools to trying to be strong and brave, it's a loving tribute to the special bond between a father and his son, and the hero that Daddy is in his eyes.

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: It's time for some yummy food! The kids plan a surprise dinner for their parents. They try putting ketchup on all sorts of different foods to see if it's yummy or yucky. They eat all kinds of ice cream and lollipops and learn about their favorite vegetables in a school play. Plus, they have a fun disco dance party and Jill takes her first ballet class.

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Baby John has a new ice cream machine! He makes treats for his family but adds some unusual ingredients. He also plays vet with Bingo and sings a special song about his sister, Jill. Mom teaches him how to be safe during bathtime and he and Manny have a superhero competition. Plus, the friends go to the movies for the first time and have a swimming race.

programme.title: Little Baby Bum
programme.desc: It's time to sing along to all your favorites! Max has fun in his first bath and he and Mia play peek-a-boo with their mummy. Twinkle helps Max get to sleep with some colorful magic. The family makes hand shadow puppets and Daddy Panda turns boring veggies into fun faces. Plus, the friends learn all about shapes on a fun train ride.

programme.title: Little Baby Bum
programme.desc: Get ready for Mia's spectacular sing-along! She and her friends see five little speckled frogs at the pond. The big bus gets all muddy and the friends have to work together to get it clean. They go on a fun train ride and Mia has to get her favorite bunny clean after it gets all muddy. Plus, learn about shapes, names and what to do when it rains.

programme.title: Little Baby Bum
programme.desc: Get ready to sing your heart out with Mia! She and her friend Bari pretend to be bakers and make yummy cupcakes. She and her dad take a splashy ride in her car on a rainy day. She and her friend Maple learn about big and small while playing in the garden. She also learns about avocados, kangaroos and how to make her own instruments.

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: If you're happy, sing along with JJ and friends! Enjoy story time with 'Little Bunny Foo Foo' and sing about all the animals on Grandpa's farm. Play with five little animals on a sleepy Saturday morning. Learn how to be brave on the playground, use your imagination with a pretend play song and discover all the cool shapes in your lunchbox. It's a day of happy songs and playful learning!

programme.title: Dance Party
programme.desc: Grab your instrument and march along to 'John Jacob Jingleheimer Schmidt!' Get into the holiday spirit with 'Up on the Housetop' and 'Deck the Halls.' Make a splash down by the bay and get active with fun exercise dance moves. Crawl like the Itsy Bitsy Spider, swim with the mermaids and do the 'Chuchuwa' dance. It's a musical marching adventure!

programme.title: Nina Time
programme.desc: Get ready for Nina's song and dance! The friends dance with all the baby animals at the petting zoo. They go on a scavenger hunt to find flowers that match the colors of the rainbow. They dream of flying high in the sky like their pilot dad. Nina chases a surprise egg through the grocery store and tries to catch bubbles without popping them. Plus, she celebrates her birthday with a piñata and learns some healthy habits.

programme.desc: Buster has a wobbly tooth and it's the start of a big adventure! After getting hit by a football, he and his friends race to the dentist. He and his friends get stuck in the mud on their way to see shooting stars and get lost in a storm in the woods. Buster also gets a surprise paint job, becomes a flying superhero and discovers a monster in the frightful forest.

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: It's time to get ready to go out! Baby John learns how to tie his own shoes. He collects all the dirty socks in the house to put on a puppet show. He gets a new pair of light-up shoes, but the lights stop working when he gets them wet. Jill has a fashion parade with the family and they all go on a road trip in a camper van. Plus, Baby John learns how to get ready for his swimming lessons.

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Get ready for some outdoor fun! The family has a movie night in their backyard. Baby John helps his dad deliver packages in his truck. The family goes on a trip to the Grand Canyon and has a fun day at the splash pad. The kids turn their playground into a beach, learn how to fly a kite and have a mini-golf competition.

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: It's always important to be good and remember your manners! Bingo learns how to play nicely with other dogs and take a bath. Baby John learns that sharing is caring and that it's not polite to interrupt. At school, he learns how to play nice and be fair with his friends. The family learns about fire safety and that sometimes, it's okay to ask for help.

programme.title: Morphle
programme.desc: A strange magic is bringing objects to life all over Petport, and Jordie is the first to notice when his bed sprouts legs and runs away! While chasing it, Mila and Morphle discover the problem is bigger than they thought, as they must also wrangle a magic carpet on a wild flight. Their adventure is a frantic chase to catch and calm the enchanted items causing chaos across the city.

programme.title: Morphle
programme.desc: Every day is an adventure with Mila and her best friend, Morphle! When a ball gets stuck in a tree or a friend needs help, Mila knows just what to do. Morphle can morph into a ladder, a fire truck, or anything she can imagine, turning everyday problems into exciting, magical solutions and proving that he's the best magic pet a girl could ask for.

programme.title: Morphle
programme.desc: Mila and Morphle are hoping for a peaceful day of projects, starting with planting a vegetable garden. But when their magic seeds sprout into enormous, uncontrollable veggies, their plans get complicated! Their day is further interrupted when they must stop Orphle, who is recklessly driving a construction digger and threatening to ruin their garden and their entry for the town baking contest.

programme.title: Gecko's Garage
programme.desc: Get ready for some Baby Bus Mayhem! Baby Truck and Molly learn the importance of sharing their toys. A magic show takes a turn when Yellow Mechanical gets stuck to a giant magnet. At firefighter school, Dandy gets himself into a tricky situation. Weasel causes trouble by cheating in a football match and showing off his faulty gadgets at the fix-up fair, but Gecko and Grandma are there to save the day.

programme.title: Gecko's Garage
programme.desc: Get ready for some amazing adventures with Gecko and friends! When Tilly the tow truck gets sick before a beach trip, Trevor helps create a sandy surprise at the garage. Weasel causes a cake catastrophe and Gecko has to save the day. The team fixes Fiona's control panel during a campout and when Blue gets lost, Gecko comes to the rescue. It's a day of heroes, mysteries and fun!

programme.title: Gecko's Garage
programme.desc: Baby Truck is always ready for an adventure, and today he's leading his friends on an exciting exploration! Their playtime takes a messy turn when Baby Truck's curiosity gets the better of him, and he ends up stuck deep in the mud. It looks like he's in real trouble, but his friends won't leave him behind. This is a wonderful tale of how the smallest heroes, working together as a team, can solve even the stickiest of problems.

programme.title: Summer Seafood Smorgasbord

programme.title: Feast of Killer Crab & Perfect Pork Belly
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde prepares a finger food feast with char grilled chili crab, spiced adobo potatoes, grilled pork belly, & sofrito stuffed branzino all served on a bed of rice over banana leaves. Call your friends - this is a feast that will feed many!

programme.title: Deluxe Dogs with Crusted Corn & Potatoes
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde puts a modern spin on a classic All-American cookout with his loaded hot dogs, spiced smashed potato salad, chorizo & corn nut crusted corn, and bangin’ banana pudding pops. Sparklers out for this spread!

programme.title: Pizzapalooza
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde is throwin’ down a pizza spread like never before with his Chicago-style tavern pie with sausage & onion, a grilled pizza pocket with pepperoni & cheese, chicken wings a la pizzaiola, and a zesty grilled caesar salad to finish it off.

programme.title: Scrumptious Summer Sandwiches
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde channels his inner sandwich lover by making an angry lobster club with pepper aioli and grilled bacon, a lamb birria torta with avocado and ramen consomme, and his an Italian beef combo with chili crisp cheese sauce, and giardiniera.

programme.title: Top of the Line Steaks

programme.title: It's Taco Time
programme.desc: Tacos are the way to Chef Dale’s heart, and to prove it, he’s grilling up a sweet and smoky lemongrass and guajillo pork with pineapple, served with coconut and cotija cheese corn and an avocado jicama salad.

programme.title: Restaurant-Style Whole Roast Fish
programme.desc: Grilling isn’t only about fast and casual dinners. Chef Dale grills to impress with this elegant, restaurant quality meal of whole roasted fish, coconut milk grits, and snow pea, watermelon and tamarind salad.

programme.title: The Chicken Episode
programme.desc: If you’re going to grill chicken, you’ll want to make it good. Chef Dale likes to kick up the heat with his angry chicken, a spicy, spatchcocked and grilled whole chicken, and his kung pao chicken wings.

programme.title: Brunch On The Grill
programme.desc: Wake up, it’s time to grill! Chef Dale greets the day with a showstopping dutch baby pancake and tangerine syrup, crispy hash browns topped with creme fraiche and roe, and a ham steak smothered in sweet cherry mostarda and red eye gravy.

programme.title: Vegetables, But Delicious
programme.desc: Grilling is the perfect way to imbue your veggies with deliciousness. Chef Dale crafts a family style platter of trumpet mushrooms, eggplant marinated in spicy ssam jang, and charred yellow squash served with a green goddess dressing.

programme.title: Kabobs and Skewers
programme.desc: Kabobs and skewers are a family tradition for Chef Dale. This Mediterranean-inspired meal features beef and shrimp kabobs with grilled tomatoes, potatoes, and eggplant, all served on warm pita with a tangy white sauce.

programme.desc: The end of summer is near, and Chef Dale goes out in style with a giant seafood feast! Lobster, crab, clams, shrimp, and scallops, all served directly on the table with plenty of buttery garlic bread. Thanks for watching, and until we grill again!

programme.desc: Alex Hill throws a pizza party with her delicious homemade pies! She creates a sweet and savory pie with spicy pepperoni & pineapple, a tangy BBQ chicken pizza, a grandma deep dish pie with mozzarella & chorizo, and an herby salad flatbread.

programme.title: Plantains and Rice, Baby
programme.desc: Alex Hill celebrates Hispanic Heritage Month with her mom’s recipes as well as some of her own. She’ll whip up a coconut coquito cocktail, Cuban-style black beans, a garlicky arroz con pollo with sofrito, and some salty and sweet plantains.

programme.title: Moroccan Lamb with Sangria, Baby
programme.desc: Alex Hill welcomes the coziness of fall with some fabulous flavors & dishes including Moroccan lamb with dates & harissa, fall sangria with apples & amaretto, garlicky rice pilaf, roasted root vegetables, and crispy cucumber salad. It’s fall y’all!

programme.title: Doing Brunch Right, Baby
programme.desc: Alex Hill brings big brunch vibes with her favorite weekend dishes including NY-style bacon, egg, and cheese sandwich with black pepper bacon, Maryland-style Old Bay crab cake benedict, coquito French toast bites, and a berry-ful Aperol spritz!

programme.title: Tacos and Margaritas, Baby
programme.desc: Alex Hill hosts a heavenly girls night in, complete with sweet potato tacos with roasted corn salsa, carne asada tacos with orange & spice, and crab and shrimp enchiladas with chili verde. She tops it all off with a fabulous margarita station.

programme.title: Pizza Party on the Grill
programme.desc: It’s Pizza Time! Chef Dale Talde grills up amazing pizzas for every palate including a Detroit Style Pie, a Cheddar Naan Pie with a Spiced Chick Peas & Potatoes, and gives your childhood favorite French Bread Pizza a much needed upgrade.

programme.title: Grill These Sandwiches
programme.desc: Mad Good Food Host Derrell Smith joins Chef Dale Talde at the grill as they cook up some stupendous sandwiches including a Salmon Pastrami Reuben, a Meatball Banh Mi, and even some Grilled Ice Cream Sandwiches.

programme.title: New Orleans-Style Shrimp & Oysters
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde brings us to the bayou as he creates a NOLA-inspired menu complete with Chargrilled Oysters, Black Pepper Shrimp Po’boys, finishes it off with Bananas Foster, and washes it all down with a Fruity Grilled Hurricane.

programme.title: Sunday Vietnamese Brisket with Noodles
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde shows us how he does Sunday up right as he grills up some Vietnamese Brisket with Rice Noodles, Crispy Swordfish Summer Rolls, and tops it all off with some tasty Soju Floats. Hey, it’s Sunday somewhere, right?

programme.title: Smash Burgers & A Slice in Los Angeles
programme.desc: Frankie Celenza heads to all the buzzworthy spots in LA - cooking up calamari steak at a classic Mexican joint, tasting taro root donuts with fun flavors, grabbing a guanciale slice, and hopping on the line to make cheesy scrumptious smash burgers.

programme.title: Tacos, Brats, & Biscuits in Austin
programme.desc: Frankie Celenza goes down south to try Austin’s best bets - breakfast tacos are on the itinerary, as well as a bangin’ beer garden & sausage house, loaded biscuits, and dessert pancakes to boot! Austin may be weird but the food is fabulous.

programme.title: Brooklyn’s Best Pizza Tour
programme.desc: Frankie Celenza goes on the best pizza party crawl that Brooklyn has to offer. He’ll try a Neo-Neapolitan pie, a classic coal oven favorite, he’ll hit up a modern joint with innovative toppings, and a cozy Italian-owned neighborhood spot.

programme.title: BBQ Bowls & Puffy Tacos in San Antonio
programme.desc: Frankie Celenza gets his spurs on to sample San Antonio’s best all-day brunch, taste some epic puffy tacos at a classic car joint, create colorful conchitas, and bask in the beauty of BBQ Thai curry bowls.

programme.title: Dropped - S03:E07 - Salmon Island
programme.desc: Now that most of the waterfowl have headed further south for migration, brothers Chris and Casey Keefer are putting their efforts into fishing to get the calories they need. They're heading back downriver after packing up camp, zeroing in on an area they think has several moose.

programme.title: Dropped - S03:E08 - Log Jammed
programme.desc: While the brothers get closer to a part of the river packed with moose, they face a bunch of problems. They have to find a way around and carry their stuff over a huge pile of logs that could mess up their hunt, possibly pushing them into a part of the river they weren't ready for.

programme.title: Dropped - S03:E09 - Bull In The Bush
programme.desc: After more than three weeks trekking through moose country, brothers Chris and Casey Keefer finally set up camp in a new spot and almost immediately come face-to-face with a massive bull.

programme.title: Dropped - S03:E10 - End Of The Line
programme.desc: With the odds piling against them, the 80-mile river adventure is almost over, and brothers Chris and Casey Keefer have one final opportunity to find an Alaskan moose just a few miles from where they'll be picked up at the river junction.

programme.title: The Trail - S01:E06 - On the Move
programme.desc: Laramy and Seven leave camp Hell Hole and hit the trail again. They are headed for lower elevation in search of a more permanent place to call home.

programme.title: The Trail - S01:E07 - Permanent Residence
programme.desc: Laramy and Seven find a long term camping spot out fo the snow and at a lower elevation. Laramy gets to work making a more permanent shelter and looking for food.

programme.title: The Trail - S01:E08 - Focused on Food
programme.desc: Laramy locates some whitetail deer and focuses his efforts on hunting them.

programme.title: The Trail - S01:E09 - Thriving
programme.desc: Stocked up on food, Laramy and Seven thrive in their new location. Laramy focuses on building some amenities to make life easier on The Trail.

programme.title: The Trail - S01:E10 - Return Home
programme.desc: Laramy and Seven say goodbye to their final camp and head back home.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S03:E02 - Nightmare Canyon Part 2
programme.desc: Part 2: Justin and Jeremy Harris's climbing weekend has resulted in serious jeopardy for the brothers. With Justin totally incapacitated when he breaks his leg it is up to Jeremy to go it alone and try and raise help. As night falls and temperatures drop to freezing time is critical if the brothers are to survive.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S03:E03 - Under the Desert Sun
programme.desc: Ed Rosenthal set out for a short hike in Joshua Tree National Park, but in the heat of the day he became turned around and lost. His six-day ordeal of survival in blazing temperatures with no food or water is nothing short of miraculous.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E12 - The New Royals
programme.desc: Princesses Beatrice and Eugenie have gone through a lot of media attention and tough situations in their lives. From their parents' very public split to being targeted by the press, they've been through quite a bit. Despite all this, they remain dedicated to supporting the monarchy with their charity work. Through serving the Commonwealth, both sisters continue to make a positive impact.

programme.title: Wardens - S01:E07 - Operation Spotted Dog
programme.desc: Working to protect our treasured natural resources in some of the country's most secluded spots means there's never a boring day on the job.

programme.title: Wardens - S01:E08 - Operation Boat Float
programme.desc: In the shade of the wild mountains, the Yellowstone River transforms into a colorful spectacle during the yearly boat float weekend. Armed with jet boats, the Wardens gear up for a wild time, looking out for the river and helping out the wacky rafters.

programme.title: Dropped - S01:E10 - Return Home
programme.desc: Casey’s bull disappeared downstream quickly, heading into uncharted waters the brothers hadn’t explored yet. They’re eager to see what happens next.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S03:E05 - Juno, Cassini and Beyond
programme.desc: The Cassini space craft has completed its mission over Saturn, Juno has reached its target and has commenced its scientific observations of the giant planet Jupiter. and The New Horizons speeds on it its next encounter at the edge of the solar system.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S03:E06 - Sling Shot
programme.desc: Sending probes throughout the solar system is a mathematicians dream and an engineers nightmare, sling shotting probes around other planets to arrive at their destination, we checkout the latest probes about to slingshot about the solar system.

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E09 - Private Military Contractors
programme.desc: The practice of hiring private armies goes back to ancient times, and the mystique associated with the mercenary warrior has been the subject of many historical studies and fictional characterizations. This episode of CQB takes a more contemporary look at a day in the life of a group of civilian contractors, and how their role has evolved on the modern battlefield. Using its "sub-second" analysis techniques and intimate first-person footage, CQB reveals the backgrounds, training and equipment of today’s "soldiers for hire" and how private armies are re-shaping the way conflicts are conducted around the world.

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E10 - Close Protection
programme.desc: From the elite ex-special forces personnel in charge of guarding heads of state in conflict zones to the two-person teams that protect CEOs in dangerous regions, modern day bodyguards must be well versed in close quarter battle techniques. An immense amount of planning and preparation is involved in each operation. From air travel, car convoys and helicopter shuttles to basic foot traffic, a close protection squad must be completely tuned to the Who, What, Where and When of any given situation. This episode of CQB focuses on the complex day-to-day and minute-to-minute operations of these elite teams and the highly developed techniques they employ.

programme.title: Jim Shockey's Uncharted - S01:E04 - The Bears that Couldn't Be
programme.desc: Temperate Rain Forest. Jim and Corey search for an epic hunting spot deep in the coastal rain forest of Vancouver Island that Jim last explored 20 years ago.

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E11 - Counter Terrorism
programme.desc: Following the September 11 attacks, military presence became commonplace in New York and other American cities, and the counter terrorism forces were effectively given a "blank cheque" when it came to ensuring that another terrorist incident would never take place on American soil. This episode of CQB takes an in–depth look at who was selected to occupy elite anti-terrorist positions, what they were trained for, and how they were equipped: when opposing forces are using commercial airliners and chemical weapons, countermeasures are by necessity complicated and varied. CQB takes an intimate look at what it was like to be an officer on alert for chemical attacks in Washington DC, or an army reservist monitoring suspicious activities on the streets of NYC.

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E12 - French Foreign Legion
programme.desc: No country other than France operates an elite military force that invites foreign nationals to serve in its ranks. With a reputation for being a safe haven for individuals with questionable pasts, the French Foreign Legion is a true mercenary army that has garnered significant respect within the global special operations community. This episode of CQB examines a raid by the Foreign Legion on a small airport in Iraq during the 1990 Gulf War, exploring the nature of the Legion, how it differs from other special forces, and how it prepares for a wide variety of close quarter battle scenarios in conflict situations around the world.

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R. - S02:E04 - Elephant Country
programme.desc: Ivan joins the foremost anti-poaching team in Mozambique to bring down one particular group of poachers who have been killing local elephants for their ivory.

programme.title: Wild Ones - S01:E05 - Strongest
programme.desc: How do you decide which is the strongest animal on the Planet? Wild Ones looks at the comparative strength of the tiniest of ants to that of a might grizzly bear, or a deadly crocodile to the indestructible rhinoceros.

programme.title: Wild Ones - S01:E06 - Cutest
programme.desc: The charming kangaroo. The cuddly koala. The beautiful butterfly. The cheerful clownfish. Or the adorable budgie - which one is the cutest of them all?

programme.title: Wild Ones - S01:E07 - Wild Australia
programme.desc: More than 80 percent of Australia’s plants, mammals, reptiles and frogs are unique to Australia and are found nowhere else in the world. Wild dingos, frisky kangaroos, deceptively cuddly looking koalas and playful platypuses are some of the most iconic of Australia’s wild animals.

programme.title: Wild Ones - S01:E08 - Masters of the Sky
programme.desc: So many words describe the many ways that birds fly – pelicans and kestrels soar but owls fly silently. Parrots flock, vultures swarm and eagles swoop. Radar-accurate eyes scan the ground and slotted feathers adjust flight paths as hawks attack. But, which is the true master of the sky?

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E02- Naturally Noble
programme.desc: Zimbabwe was initially Southern Rhodesia and lies to the south of the Victoria Falls along the river Zambezi. Zambia was initially Northern Rhodesia and lies on the other bank of the river. Zimbabwe is a landlocked country in the south-east of Africa. It borders with South Africa to the south. According to archaeologists, the earliest records indicate that first human settlements in this area reach back to the 3rd century.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E03 - Naturally Sustaining
programme.desc: We journey in search of incredible miracles of nature begins on the Canary Islands. Lanzarote is of a volcanic origin. Volcanic activity created a fantastical landscape, similar to that on Mars. On Gran Canarias we will witness a traditional harvest of a crop that has been brought to the rest of the world from here - sugarcane. We will wrap up this episode in the Moroccan province of Gulemin, a home to a nomadic tribe whose inseparable companions are camels.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E04 - Naturally Colourful
programme.desc: Venture into the Mexican seaside state of Veracruz in the south-west of the country and admire the unbelievable colours of locally grown orchids. Find out how vanilla is grown and discover how brown sugar is made. To top things off, witness an extraordinary ritual. Later, we will visit the Cayman Islands in the Caribbean. The three islands are relatively small but are inhabited by some remarkable animals including sea turtles, friendly rays and other types of fish as well as fascinating blue iguanas.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E05 - Naturally Enigmatic
programme.desc: Today we will visit three remarkable nooks of Europe in search of miracles of nature. To begin with, we will venture into Austria's Salzburg region. An area that is famous for its Alps and Tauern mountains but also because it is the birth place of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart. After that, we will move over to the south western outpost of the old continent, to Portugal's Algarve region. To conclude, we will admire Corsica, the French island of beauty.

programme.title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S04:E10 - Montana Whitetail
programme.desc: Laramy embraces the challeges presented when hunting Whitetail deer in Montana.

programme.title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S04:E11 - Moose
programme.desc: Laramy has spotted some huge moose, now he just needs to hope his Hawken shoots straight and true!

programme.title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S04:E12 - Bear Part 2
programme.desc: The bigger the challenge, the bigger the reward as Laramy continues his hunt for bear in the Rockies.

programme.title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S04:E13 - Hunt of a Mountain Man
programme.desc: Laramy shows us how hunting was done in the mid 1800s by the Mountain Men, where unusual skills and stalking techniques were needed to survive throughout the winter. Harsh Winters were known as White Death to the Mountain Men.

programme.title: Wild Ones - S01:E07 - Wild Australia
programme.desc: More than 80 percent of Australia’s plants, mammals, reptiles and frogs are unique to Australia and are found nowhere else in the world. Wild dingos, frisky kangaroos, deceptively cuddly looking koalas and playful platypuses are some of the most iconic of Australia’s wild animals.

programme.title: Wild Ones - S01:E08 - Masters of the Sky
programme.desc: So many words describe the many ways that birds fly – pelicans and kestrels soar but owls fly silently. Parrots flock, vultures swarm and eagles swoop. Radar-accurate eyes scan the ground and slotted feathers adjust flight paths as hawks attack. But, which is the true master of the sky?

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E02- Naturally Noble
programme.desc: Zimbabwe was initially Southern Rhodesia and lies to the south of the Victoria Falls along the river Zambezi. According to archaeologists, the earliest records indicate that first human settlements in this area reach back to the 3rd century.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E03 - Naturally Sustaining
programme.desc: We journey in search of incredible miracles of nature begins on the Canary Islands. Lanzarote is of a volcanic origin. We will wrap up this episode in the Moroccan province of Gulemin, a home to a nomadic tribe whose inseparable companions are camels.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E04 - Naturally Colourful
